summary: Fullstack Developer with 4+ years of experience building production-grade systems for critical sectors such as government, logistics, healthcare, and insurance. Specialized in high-performance backend development (Python/Django, .NET Core), reactive frontends (Angular/TypeScript), and active AI integration (LLM APIs, NLP, cognitive workflow automation). Proven ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable architectures and solve high-impact technical challenges.

key_competencies.name: AI & Backend Architecture
key_competencies.description: Design and implementation of high‑performance backend services using Python, Django, FastAPI and .NET Core, often enriched with large language model capabilities.

key_competencies.name: RPA and Autonomous Agents
key_competencies.description: Architected autonomous web‑navigation engines and RPA workflows with Python, Playwright and LLM APIs to extract unstructured data without manual intervention.

key_competencies.name: Workflow Orchestration
key_competencies.description: Built event‑driven business processes using n8n, integrating RESTful APIs, Kafka and Celery for real‑time data synchronization.

key_competencies.name: Scalable Cloud Deployments
key_competencies.description: Deployed containerized and serverless solutions on AWS and Azure, leveraging Docker, Kubernetes, Lambda, Fargate and Terraform for CI/CD pipelines.

key_competencies.name: Fullstack Integration
key_competencies.description: Unified Angular front‑ends with Django/FASTAPI back‑ends via OpenAPI/Swagger, ensuring maintainable and documented communication layers.

notable_project.name: Autonomous RPA & AI Agent Platform (S.E.R. Consultory)
notable_project.description: Architected a suite of autonomous web‑navigation agents that use Playwright and LLMs (Claude/OpenAI) to extract, cleanse and ingest massive volumes of unstructured data into third‑party platforms, coupled with real‑time AI copilots for decision support.
notable_project.impact: Eliminated manual data entry, reducing processing time by over 80% and enabling continuous, error‑free data pipelines for critical business operations.
